set.body: ADR 0028 section 2. tools/source_identity/graph_reader.py reads v2 for the assessor. Typed refusals: other schemaVersion; bytes not matching the frozen SHA-256; unknown relation status; edition or part other than the assessor input declares; record times not a whole number of ticks (refuses the record). Exposes visual_mentions(part, start, end) (half-open, strict, integer ticks, exact rational conversion), mention_for_span(record, utf16_span), relation(class_a, class_b) (one uncontested class Same; any pair with a contested class unresolved; Distinct when recorded; else Unknown). Synthetic fixtures; SD1 mutants per refusal.
set.title: [evidence-binding S3d-2] Checked Python reader for the v2 graph
